title: Neon Snake
description: Guide your snake through a glowing grid, eat pellets to grow, and avoid crashing into yourself. Speed ramps up the longer you survive.

title: Memory Match
description: A card-matching memory game with increasing difficulty. Race the clock and your own recall to clear the board in as few moves as possible.

title: Constraint
description: A singleplayer platformer with over 600 levels, a build-your-own-level editor you can share via code, and multiple special theme worlds such as space, winter, and code.

title: Prism Path
description: Rotate mirrors and prisms to route lasers onto every target across 100 hand-tuned levels.

title: Ant Colony Tycoon
tagline: Grow your colony, crush the competition.
description: Gather resources, train ant units like Workers and War Ants, and expand your nest in this multiplayer strategy sim. Climb the leaderboard by out-building and out-battling rival colonies.

title: BLACKSITE
description: A tactical first-person shooter. Clear sector after sector, take down boss-tier Wardens every fifth sector, and fight solo, co-op, or PvP.

title: ARArcheoGame
tagline: Dig up the past in augmented reality.
description: A camera-based augmented reality archaeology experience — point your phone at the world around you to uncover and interact with artifacts. Built with 8th Wall; requires a mobile device with a camera.
Slide numbered tiles across a 4x4 grid, merging matching values until you reach 2048 — or keep going for a bigger score.

title: Breakout
description: Bounce the ball off your paddle to smash every brick. Miss three times and it's game over — clear a wall and the next one gets faster.

title: Minesweeper
tagline: Flag the mines, clear the field.
description: The classic logic puzzle. Reveal every safe cell without triggering one of the 10 hidden mines on a 9x9 board.

title: Pong
description: First to 7 points wins. Move your paddle with the mouse, touch, or W/S to keep the ball away from your side of the court.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe
tagline: Try to beat the unbeatable CPU.
description: Classic 3x3 tic-tac-toe against a perfect-play AI. Winning is impossible if the CPU plays optimally — can you at least force a draw every time?

title: Connect Four
description: Drop discs into a 7x6 grid and connect four in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally — before the CPU does.

title: Tetris
description: The original block-stacking classic. Rotate and drop tetrominoes to clear lines — speed ramps up as your line count climbs.

title: Whack-a-Mole
description: You've got 30 seconds and nine holes. Whack every mole the instant it pops up — they get quicker the higher your score climbs.

title: Flappy Byte
description: Tap, click, or hit space to flap through an endless field of pipes. One hit and it's over — how far can you get?

title: Sudoku
description: Every puzzle is freshly generated with a guaranteed unique solution. Pick Easy, Medium, or Hard and fill the 9x9 grid.

title: Guessle
description: Guess the hidden five-letter word in six tries. Green means right letter, right spot — yellow means it's in the word, just not there.

title: Newton's Gravity
tagline: A gravity sandbox for orbits and slingshots.
description: An interactive gravity simulation — place masses and watch orbits, collisions, and slingshot trajectories unfold in real time. Precision mouse control makes this one best on desktop.
